prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Pleasanton California?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single, objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for everyone — the right lawyer depends on your case type, how much experience you want, whether you prefer preparing for trial, and your personality fit. I can, however, help you find a top-rated personal injury lawyer in Pleasanton by either recommending reliable search resources and selection criteria or by pulling together a short list if you want me to search.

Quick guidance you can use now
- Start with credentials and experience:
  - Look for lawyers who focus on personal injury (auto crashes, slips and falls, wrongful death, workplace injuries, etc.).
  - Check how long they’ve handled injury cases and whether they have trial experience and reported settlements/verdicts.
- Check independent ratings and disciplinary records:
  - California State Bar (verify license and any discipline).
  - Avvo, Martindale-Hubbell, Super Lawyers lists, and local bar associations.
  - Google/Yelp reviews and Better Business Bureau for client feedback.
- Fee structure:
  - Most personal injury lawyers work on contingency (no fee unless you recover), typically around 33%–40% of recovery — confirm specifics and who pays costs if you lose.
- Practical qualities:
  - Clear communicator who returns calls.
  - Willingness to investigate your case and explain strategy.
  - Good local knowledge of courts, insurers and doctors in the Tri-Valley area.

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- How many years have you handled personal injury cases and what percentage of your practice is PI?
- Have you handled cases like mine? What were the outcomes?
- Do you try cases in court or mostly settle?
- Who will handle my case day-to-day (you or an associate)?
- What is your contingency fee and what additional costs will be charged?
- Can you give references from former clients?

Red flags
- Guarantees of a specific dollar outcome.
- Poor communication, slow responses.
- No written fee agreement or unclear breakdown of costs.
- Pressure to sign right away.

If you want, I can:
- Look up top-rated personal injury lawyers in Pleasanton and provide a short vetted list with links and phone numbers.
- Draft an email or script for your initial consultation.
Which would you prefer, and can you tell me briefly what type of injury/accident this is and any deadlines (e.g., statute of limitations)?
